auth.demo.title: Try Freedom Platform
auth.demo.intro: See how an organization manages its daily operations. Choose a role and open a ready-to-use demo workspace without registration.
auth.demo.prepared: Workspaces, catalog items, orders, and sample operations are already set up.
auth.demo.scope: Changes are made only inside the demo organization.
auth.demo.consent: By continuing, you agree to use the demo data only to explore the platform.
auth.demo.switchRole: After exploring one role, you can return and open the other one.
auth.demo.employeeDescription: Shifts, places, orders, menu, and daily operations.
auth.demo.adminDescription: Manage the organization, employees, catalog, finances, and settings.
auth.demo.isolated: Demo access is isolated from other organizations' data.
auth.demo.hostOnly: Demo sign-in is available only on the demo domain.
auth.demo.workspaceUnknown: Could not identify the demo workspace.
theme.regionalDescription: Language, appearance, time zone, and regional defaults for new organizations.
finance.periodNotReady: The next calendar month is not complete yet. The report can be submitted on the day after it ends.
finance.calendarCycleDescription: The period starts on the first day and ends on the last day of the calendar month.
finance.calendarPeriodRule: Financial periods close as complete calendar months without gaps or overlaps.
demo.welcome.title: Welcome to the Freedom Platform demo
demo.welcome.employeeIntro: This is a test employee workspace. You can safely explore daily work with places, orders, the menu, and timers.
demo.welcome.adminIntro: This is a test administrator dashboard. You can safely explore workspace, catalog, employee, finance, and settings management.
demo.welcome.safeDescription: Changes affect only the demo organization and never touch real customer accounts.
demo.welcome.employeeStepOne: Open a workspace card and create a test order.
demo.welcome.employeeStepTwo: Add products or services, start a timer, and try completing a payment.
demo.welcome.employeeStepThree: Explore the menu and shift page — the demo shift is prepared automatically.
demo.welcome.adminStepOne: Configure workspaces, categories, products, and services however you like.
demo.welcome.adminStepTwo: Explore employees, inventory, reports, finances, and organization settings.
demo.welcome.adminStepThree: Sign out and enter as an employee to test the workspace you configured.
demo.welcome.tryAnything: Feel free to use every control and change test data.
demo.welcome.autoReset: After 60 minutes of inactivity, open orders, timers, and the shift reset, and the current sign-in ends.
demo.welcome.switchRole: Sign out to switch between the employee and administrator roles.
demo.shift.preparingDescription: The shift opens automatically — there is nothing to select or enter.
demo.shift.readyTitle: The demo shift is already open
demo.shift.readyDescription: You can immediately work with workspace cards, orders, products, and timers. The demo does not require you to open or close a shift manually.
demo.shift.howItWorksTitle: How this works in a real project
demo.shift.realProjectDescription: In a regular organization, an employee opens a shift before work, enters the opening cash amount, then reconciles the cash register and closes the shift at the end.
demo.shift.demoDescription: The demo creates a shift automatically so you can start exploring the workflow immediately.
demo.shift.resetDescription: Test activity is cleared automatically after 60 minutes of inactivity. On the next sign-in, the system prepares a fresh demo shift.
